title: libds data model
preamble:
# libds data model

The data structures of libds: the struct layouts,
enums, ownership rules, and inter-module data-flow
shapes that [IARC] references abstractly.

It takes these decisions of [IARC] as fixed:

- `ds_result_t` at every call site ([IARC.1.12]).
- Per-object `malloc` with single ownership
  ([IARC.1.13]).
- One `ds_engine_t` = one independent engine
  ([IARC.1.11]).
- Thread-free / async-first ([IARC.1.10]) — no
  atomics, no locks, no thread-local state in
  struct layouts.
- Opaque handles ([IARC.1.8]).

## What this is not

- Not a wire-format spec. libds has no wire format —
  see [IARC.2.3].
  Integrators that bridge libds across processes pick
  their own encoding.
- Not the Rete-network internals reference. The native
  matching network (alpha / beta / terminal nodes,
  tokens) is specified in [IRET]; this
  doc covers the cross-module data structures, not the
  network internals.
- Not an action-dispatch spec. Dispatcher behaviour
  is its own doc, [IDSP].
- Not an error-code taxonomy. `ds_result_t`'s shape
  is here; the full enum of `ds_status_t` values
  and detail-string stability rules are in
  [IERR].
